mentions.name: Classroom CO2 Monitor
mentions.description: This device is a CO2 monitor purpose-built for older classrooms with no central air exchange. It features an easy traffic light system for indicating CO2 levels and provides a tailored ventilation guide based on the shape and size of the room.
mentions.problem: Existing CO2 monitors are not optimized for older classrooms without central air exchange.
mentions.audience: Aimed at older classrooms that lack central air exchange.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am trying to develop a CO2 monitor specifically for older classrooms with no central air exchange with some friends. CO2 monitors already exist but none are actually optimized for this specific case.

Our device has an easy traffic light system, and a tailored guide to ventilation based on the shape and size of the room.
